why: B gives a proper adjustable reading lamp and a dark wood side table that matches the bookcase and floor. Its cognac leather chair adds warmth, so the whole set reads as one cohesive reading nook. A's rice-paper column lamp is ambient rather than a reading light, and its brass-and-walnut nesting tables bring a glam note and a third wood tone, so it holds together less well. Both use a single 90 cm bookcase, which falls short of filling a good part of the left wall.
